# netbox_journal_entries (Data Source)

Retrieves all journal entries from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_journal_entries" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "assigned_object_id"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "journal_entries_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_journal_entries.example.journal_entries[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `journal_entries` (Attributes List) The journal entries found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--journal_entries))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--journal_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `journal_entries`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_object` (String) The assigned object of the journal entries.
- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The assigned object id of the journal entries.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the journal entries.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the journal entries.
- `created` (String) When the journal entries was created.
- `created_by` (Number) The created by of the journal entries.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the journal entries, as a map of field name to value.
- `id` (Number) The id of the journal entries.
- `kind` (String) The kind of the journal entries.
- `last_updated` (String) When the journal entries was last changed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
